The most prominent is the high priest Hilkiah in the reign of King Josiah, who famously discovered the Book of the Law in the temple (2 Kings 22). With 34 occurrences spread across 7 books, the name appears most frequently in 2 Kings (11 times) and 2 Chronicles (8 times), reflecting its concentration in the historical literature of the monarchy and restoration periods.
